tree: In 2023, five researchers from DeepMind came together around a shared conviction: cutting-edge AI research had never really been applied to the day-to-day operations of enterprises. They set out to change that.

Most work still happens in browsers, desktop software, and systems that were never designed to work together, and most of them have no API. H Company builds agents that operate there directly: they read the interface, decide what to do next, and act through the screen the way a person does.

We have held this conviction since 2023, well before the rest of the market started talking about computer use. H Company began with a focused bet on one domain. It is now a platform built to operate across the full range of environments where enterprise work happens.
